data.name: Kapoor
data.gender_notes: Kapoor is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Krishna’ meaning black, Kapoor is a traditional Indian name with deep spiritual significance. It is believed that those named Kapoor are blessed with the divine qualities of Lord Krishna, including wisdom, compassion, and courage. The name Kapoor carries the meaning “Black” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kapoor usually hope their child will grow to embody black and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the divine qualities of Lord Krishna.
data.etymology: Kapoor belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Black.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kapoor total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The surname Kapoor holds great cultural significance in India and beyond, where it is associated with the Indian film industry, particularly in the Bollywood sector. The Kapoor family is a leading Bollywood dynasty, having produced several renowned actors and filmmakers. As a result, the name has come to represent creativity, innovation, and excellence in the field of entertainment.
data.spiritual_significance: In its original form, the name Kapoor carries a profound spiritual significance, as it is believed to be a reminder of one's essential connection to the divine. It is also believed to serve as a constant inspiration to live in accordance with the virtues of Lord Krishna, such as kindness, selflessness, and a deep understanding of the interconnectedness of all beings.
